The paths: the student (refused at the School through execute; a month at the School meets the rules at an application and at a renewal), eligibility (income the clock paid placing her in HUSKY D, Covered Connecticut or the marketplace; F-1 status at enrollment and at renewal; the income, age and SNAP exceptions), enrollment (Enroll pressed on Papers, the program's start, the marketplace's premium, the duplicate refusal across a reload), renewal (kept, moved both ways, a notice and the end said ahead, one jump against day by day, with a reload) and hardship (a renewal's notice and an application's answered by Request A Hardship Exception, and its refusal with no stay). I read the new School-route renewal (scope-cover '…on a personal leave from 20 January 2027, she enrolls in HUSKY D on Papers on 21 January…') whole. The leave comes by school.request_leave, Enroll is pressed on the drawn Papers, and a reload falls before the renewal. My own reading gives its literal: lookBack for 1 July reads January to June, the leave's startedAt of 20 January isn't before 1 January, so January is a month at the School (enrolledIn), and the months after it are wholly on the leave and under $580. The twin changes only the day she enrolls and gets the notice, so the test isn't vacuous. GUARD and FIXTURE tests (under 19, the ten days crossing a month, the reach-back limits, the ended-program hardship, defects-g8-4's hours and income tests, remaining-health-billing's posted-wages FIXTURE) are listed apart, each with the state play can't reach that it holds.
